# Model Supply Chain Scanner

> A static scanner that finds code execution, file access and malformed structure in machine learning model files before they are loaded, without importing or running anything from them.

Languages: Python, Rust. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/model-supply-chain-scanner

## Source

- [src/msscan/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/model-supply-chain-scanner/blob/main/src/msscan/__init__.py): Scan machine learning model files for code execution and unsafe content before loading them.
- [src/msscan/api.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/model-supply-chain-scanner/blob/main/src/msscan/api.py): Typed wrappers around the Rust core.
- [src/msscan/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/model-supply-chain-scanner/blob/main/src/msscan/cli.py): Command line: ``python -m msscan scan|rules|serve``.
- [src/msscan/reference.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/model-supply-chain-scanner/blob/main/src/msscan/reference.py): A readable reference for the pickle import and call analysis, used only by parity tests.
